product_one_liner.value: Mimica observes how enterprise teams perform work, maps their end-to-end processes, and creates AI agents to automate those processes.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes process analysis, mapping, and building AI agents for organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The contact page invites users to request product information, pricing, or a demo, but presents no public prices or pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in the company's case studies.

employee_band.notes: Mimica's LinkedIn company profile lists its size as 201-500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company gives its address as 107 Cheapside, London, UK.

founded_year.notes: The company's history timeline identifies 2018 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The articles index shows educational, product, business-impact, and company-news content, but does not show at least two posts by engineers explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to product, case studies, resources, articles, privacy, and webinars, but no public documentation site or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Mimica has a listed Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer opening.

model_provider.notes: The product and privacy information reviewed, including the privacy policy's service-provider disclosure, does not name an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited Mimica article explicitly says it is compliant with GDPR, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.

last_funding.notes: Mimica announced a $26.2 million Series B on September 24, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series B was within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Mimica's job listings include a Business Development Representative and an Enterprise & Strategic Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica announced its Maker product on September 30, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company's about page identifies its CEO and CTO as founders and reports no leadership join or departure in the relevant period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Development Representative job listing mentions Salesforce for maintaining account, deal-size, and status information.
